scope: Read-only discovery and documentation review; no deployment, upload, rollback, login, infrastructure change or dependency installation performed by this audit.

cli.provenanceLimit: Existing package and cache-lock metadata plus local file hashes inspected; registry tarball contents were not independently redownloaded or compared.
cli.telemetry: WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false set only for audited CLI processes

authentication.limit: A successful whoami establishes current CLI identity and reported permissions, not a successful future deployment or a fresh Cloudflare connector session.

recommendedAlternative.method: Invoke the existing cached Wrangler directly through Node; no npx invocation, installation, token extraction or connector reauthentication is needed for this available CLI path.
prerequisites: Capture the current remote deployment and version before the production write; do not use historical report identity without live verification.
Review remote settings against wrangler.jsonc and ensure RELEASE_COMMIT identifies the reviewed source release.
Dry run verifies local packaging, then production deployment must be followed by live route, asset, behavior, header and release-identity checks.
Rollback immediately activates the specified version; linked resource data and trigger changes are not restored by code rollback.

apiAlternative.status: Supported by current official docs but unnecessary while the authenticated cached CLI works; no API mutation attempted.
steps: POST /accounts/{account_id}/workers/assets/upload?base64=true with required multipart asset batches and the session upload authorization.
Use the resulting completion token in multipart metadata to upload a Worker version through POST /accounts/{account_id}/workers/scripts/{script_name}/versions, which does not deploy it.
Activate the chosen version through a separate deployment operation, or use the script upload endpoint when an immediate deployment is intended.
cautions: The direct-upload guide prefers Wrangler for normal site delivery.
Asset upload and completion JWT values are sensitive and must stay out of logs and evidence artifacts.
The keep_assets option reuses existing assets; it is unsuitable when publishing changed site assets.
Rollback supports only the 100 most recently published versions and can be blocked by incompatible resource changes.
